game.name: Stardew Valley (RG34XXSP / KNULLI)
game.desc: Stardew Valley mainline PortMaster adaptation for Anbernic RG34XXSP running KNULLI. Includes built-in motor rumble, startup preparation caching and optional SMAPI. Requires your own clean Windows or Linux Steam mainline game files. Experimental ARM64 community port; see the repository README for installation and current limits.
